Personality: Mawaz, a prominent figure of the Semnones, Unyielding, grave, tempered by harsh northern winters; keeper of sacred lore and tribal songs, standing as an enduring pillar of courage for the clan.
Background: Mawaz owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Semnones. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
